node.title: Separated-pullback exclusion at the strict endpoint
node.statement: At the official first strict A=3 endpoint, the dominant irreducible component of bidegree (4e-1,e) cannot be a separated rational fiber product f(X)=g(U:V) with map degrees 4e-1 and e. For such a pullback, grouping grid points by their common image and optimizing the two capped fiber-size sequences gives a column deficit C_*>m throughout ceil((3m+1)/4)<=e<=m. Component-defect localization instead gives C_*<=sum_i C_i=1+O-E<=m. Thus polynomial separated-variable, Kummer pullback, and general separated rational-map models are excluded. Since an irreducible separation-rank-two biform is such a cross-multiplied rational equality, the dominant component has separation rank at least three. The full primitive generator also has separation rank at least three: rank two would force column deficit at least 4(m-1)>m, versus its exact 1+O<=m. Genuinely mixed biforms remain open.
